formal_results: Two closed Boolean-permutation edge policies, red and green, on the same six-arrow source satisfy primitive reversibility, source-swap covariance and all-word sequential composition
Each policy has compiled witnesses for every one of the eight vertex/bit configurations from the same A,false initialization
Both interpretation readouts are bound to actual original-rule geometric compilation for every directed word
After ABC both actual compiled readouts equal true at A; after the same additional AB continuation they equal false and true at B
The two implementations are not contextually equivalent under the frozen observation and continuation language
Independent finite census exhausts 64 edge assignments, finds eight covariant policies and four reachable policies, and separates all four contextual classes by complete paired-state reachability

interface.census_scope: All Boolean-permutation assignments to six edges; not all possible realizations or tasks
interface.formal_scope: Arbitrary directed words for two explicit survivors, including original-rule readout comparison, composition, reachability and contextual inequivalence
interface.selection_boundary: Independent declaration of a useful task does not itself imply one contextual class; classification into several classes remains valid
interface.frame_boundary: Vertex-dependent bit frames relate the finite transition presentations but do not preserve the frozen observed bit; restricting observations to returns at A changes the task

open_typed_boundaries: Which additional independently justified task law selects among the surviving contextual classes
